blocks.body: - Hit markers now properly scale with damage

blocks.title: Heroes
blocks.body:
Ashe

- Fixed a bug that caused Ashe's weapon to appear incorrectly in the Kill Feed

Genji

- Reverted a change that allowed Genji to turn slightly while using Swift Strike
- Developer Comment: This was intended as a quality of life feature but many players found it disruptive
